baseline.description: Re-pinned 2026-10-10 to green main commit 66f4e9a (Everruns 0.46, #831). The prior pin (3ad038f, 2026-10-05) predated the structured ask_user tool (#830), the task-completion controller (#824) and the Everruns 0.41 to 0.46 moves, so every ordinary control grew input tokens and cost by more than 10% (find-constant 8520 to 10977) and the nightly failed on correctness-neutral drift. Earlier history: the 2026-10-05 and 2026-09-19 re-pins and the #643 grep_files path_pattern fix (a real bug caught by this monitor, fixed in code with runtime::tests::grep_tool_matches_directory_anchored_nested_glob_path_pattern) are recorded in git history of this file. Re-pin periodically to keep the ordinary-control gates comparing against current architecture; the focused search-efficiency cases this baseline also anchors remain valid regardless of the pin date.
